title: The Emerald Cut
subtitle: A single rectangle of open light, laid clean across the finger.

stone.origin: The emerald cut is a window. Step facets create a long, open plane of reflected light rather than the scattered fire of brilliant cuts — clarity is readable, depth is visible, and the geometry of the stone presents itself directly. Three step-cut forms in sequence — the emerald center and two kite-shaped Cadillac sides — compose a single rectangle of light across the finger. Each element was chosen so the whole reads as one form.

description: The emerald cut is a window. Its long step facets return light in a wide, open plane rather than the scattered fire of a brilliant, so clarity is readable and the depth of the stone presents itself directly. Here three step-cut forms sit in sequence — an emerald centre with two kite-shaped Cadillac sides — composing a single rectangle of reflected light across the finger. Each element was chosen so the eye reads one continuous form, not three stones, in eighteen-karat white gold.
